svg.title: A modern connection drops while the manual exchange line keeps ringing.
svg.desc: During a voltage flicker, a modern indicator goes dark but the amber manual relay remains lit and the clinic line rings. Vale and Cecil watch the older circuit preserve service.
svg.text: Page 18, panel 3 · Vertical shot from flickering modern terminal to steady manual board

text.tspan: A brief power fluctuation drops the modern link
